items.title: اصلاح چرخه ارسال رویداد دامنه، cancellation و فراخوانی بازگشتی
evidence: src/Neo.Infrastructure/Data/Interceptors/DispatchDomainEventsInterceptor.cs: clears every event before publication; ignores SaveChanges cancellation; snapshots only one batch; dispatches before persistence
src/Neo.Domain/Entities/Base/IDomainEventEntity.cs: AddDomainEvents discards the result of Append and adds nothing; used by UpdateGenericEntity
acceptance: Document pre-commit local domain handlers versus durable integration events
Forward cancellation; failed and unprocessed events are not silently lost
Handle events raised by handlers within a bounded drain and reject recursive SaveChanges
Regression tests cover cancellation, handler failure, cascading events and persistence failure; no claim of distributed rollback

items.title: اصلاح قرارداد صف Hangfire و ارسال رویدادهای خروجی command
evidence: src/Neo.Infrastructure/Features/Queue/Hangfire/HangfireJobExecuter.cs: EnqueueAsync serializes a Compile/GetResult wrapper and most methods bypass injected client
src/Neo.Application/Behaviours/MediatR/PublishEventsOfCommandsBehaviour.cs: clears events before scheduling and ignores returned job id
src/Neo.Infrastructure/Features/Queue/Hangfire/HangfireOptions.cs: default queues omit outbox while DefaultOutboxJobScheduler targets outbox
acceptance: Queue actual serializable job methods with replaced CancellationToken argument using the injected client
Preserve pending response events when enqueue fails or returns no id
Make outbox queue configuration explicit and fail early for invalid settings
Tests inspect Hangfire job metadata and exercise partial enqueue failure

items.title: رفع رقابت Idempotency و مالکیت قفل توزیع‌شده
evidence: src/Neo.Application/Features/Outbox/Implementation/OutboxMessageProcessor.cs: losing concurrent enqueue returns winner before retiring its Requested row
src/Neo.Infrastructure/Features/Outbox/IdempotencyStoreWithCacheService.cs: Get then Set is not atomic
src/Neo.Infrastructure/Features/Outbox/RedisDistributedLock.cs: unconditional SetString followed by Get; release unconditionally removes another owner's lock; timeout ignored
acceptance: Losing duplicate is never left eligible for dispatch
Replace unsafe cache atomicity claims with an explicit atomic capability or fail-fast registration
Use atomic Redis acquire and owner-token compare/delete release with bounded lease semantics
Deterministic concurrent regressions and real Redis integration verify exclusivity and stale-owner release

items.title: بازیابی Outbox و ثبت نتیجه اجرای job با شناسه پیام
evidence: src/Neo.Application/Features/Outbox/Implementation/ProcessOutboxRecurringJob.cs: persists Processing before schedule; GetRequested never recovers Processing after crash; catches exceptions and uses a separate retry policy
src/Neo.Application/Features/Queue/Implementation/JobCommand.cs and JobPublisher.cs: no persisted execution outcome linked to OutboxMessage
acceptance: Carry OutboxId into execution and persist success/failure separately from enqueue acceptance
Provide bounded recovery for interrupted dispatch with explicit duplicate-delivery semantics
Keep retry and cancellation policies consistent; failures are observable
Demonstrate interrupted dispatch and successful replay without claiming arbitrary external effects are exactly-once

items.title: اتصال تراکنشی رویداد دامنه به RabbitMQ و ذخیره پایدار Saga
evidence: src/Neo.Application/Features/Outbox/Implementation/OutboxStore.cs: AddAsync calls SaveChanges separately; no mandatory shared business/outbox transaction
src/Neo.Infrastructure/Features/Messaging/RabbitMqServiceCollectionExtensions.cs: bus registration only, no transactional EF outbox
tools/Neo.Companion/samples/MessagingDemo/OrderSaga.cs and SagaParticipants.cs: state and participant ledgers are process-local
acceptance: Add opt-in EF/MassTransit transactional outbox with explicit same-DbContext usage
Runnable database-backed example maps domain event to a stable integration contract and coordinates persistent Saga state
Test rollback emits no integration message; committed pending messages survive publisher restart
Document stable event/operation IDs, reconciliation of unknown payment outcomes and multi-worker concurrency requirements

items.title: نمونه انتهابه‌انتها، پایش و هماهنگی Skills/MCP برای رویدادها
evidence: tools/Neo.Companion/docs/MESSAGING.fa.md and SAGA.fa.md currently cover an in-memory teaching Saga
src/Neo.Domain/Entities/Common/OutboxMessage.cs: enqueue and execution states exist but need documented operational semantics
acceptance: Publish a Persian guide for DDD -> transaction -> Outbox -> queue -> consumer -> compensation
Include failure/restart exercises, readiness and pending/failed work inspection
Update source snapshots, feature skill, MCP retrieval and runnable CI
Record actual tests, commits and final state per task in WorkManagement; no unresolved item marked Done
